tei:div.tei:p: (533)ser sngo bsod nams mchog ster ma la bstain nas rgyas pa'i mchod phrin las bzhugs so/

na mo ar+ya tā re ye/ rin chen rigs kyi phyag rgya mo/ bsod nams mchog ster ma la 'bud/ 'dir tshogs gnyis spel ba dang*/ rgyas pa gtso bor 'don pa'i las bzhi kha bsgyur rung ba'i mkha' 'gro'i mi mchod bya bar 'dod na rdzas la las bzhi spyi bskun dang rin po che'i rigs dang shing rtog skabs sna tshogs amṛ ta sbag pa/ las mdog dang mthun pa'i mi kheb me dar sogs tshang bar byas la/ las chu'i bum pa sgrub pa sogs tshogs chad bya'o/ gang du bya ba'i gzhi ma dul ba yin na sa chog bya/ de nas rlan can gyi rtog pa 'jo so la rdul tshon gyi re khā ril pa bzhin bus tsher po'i khar tām̐ḥ de'i phyir 'dabs bzhi la lha mtshan dang*/ phyi'i grwa bzhir zla phyed ste/ kha khyer la rin po che'i phreng ba kha dog thams cad kun nas ser por byed pa'i rdul tshon kyi khar las mthun gyi shing bzang popa btsigs pa'i mi tshang gi steng du mi khes rang mdog bcas bshams/ slob dpon g.yon gyi ste logs ci bder mchod gtor bzang po/ go dug po ci tshogs mchod srog rdzas (534) mo shing mar khu sogs dang*/ mdun du zhag chu rdor dril 'thor nas dgang blugs nang mchod bcas bshams la dngos gzhi la 'jug la skyabs sems chogs bsags sogs rjes bsang chu 'thor la/ oṃ amṛ ta bsags zhing*/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las byung ba'i bdud rtsi dwangs pa las thams cad la thogs pa med par bskul zhing lha tshogs rnams dgyes pa bskang ba'i nus ldan du gyur/ nang mchod 'thor zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ skabs 'dir bgegs bskrad srung 'khor nas nus bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs par bya'o/ las mthun gyi mo/ rtsa sngags dang*/ ag+ne ye badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la ram̐: g.yas su bskor nas thabs su bcug la/ hūm̐/ brjod pas rlung g.yas kyis me sbar/ oṃ ag+ne swā hāḥ

zhes/ blugs gzar gyi mar khu'i thig pas mi gos/ oṃḥ chos rnams rang bzhin skye ba (535)me/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i/ klong na las bzhi rdzogs pa'i thab/ spyan dang ma ki'i mkha' dbyings su/ zhal phyag spangs pa'i me lha ni/ yum chen na gza' dkar mo nyid/ dam tshig sgrol ma'i btul zhugs dang*/ mnyam sbyor byin za 'bar ba'i klong*/ bhūm̐ las 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas/ sprul pa'i zhing khams po ta la/ sogs nas las byang kyus bzhin nas/ sangs rgyas nyid kyang thob par 'gyur/ bar tshar bar bya/ dgong blugs bzung la/ hūm̐ḥ dgong blugs dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i/ zhal gyi ngo bo rnam dag cing*/ rdo rje'i ljags steng hūm̐ yig gis/ bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgyun drangs nas/ zag med bde bas rab tu mnyes/ las mthun 'od zer (536)'phros pa yis/ mchog thun dngos grub thob par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ tā re tā re tut+ta re swā hā/ tshe dang bsod nams puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru hoḥ spel ma lan bdun gyis phul/ nye bsten rgyas pa'i sngags dang*/ rnal 'byor sa bdag dang yon bdag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen bar mu ge snying stong god kha thams cad byang zhing dag nas tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang longs spyod stobs rtsal nus pa rgyas par gyur cig puṣ+ṭi ku hoḥ zhes 'dod don gsol/ de bzhin du byon skyem la mar khu lan gsum dang bsam shing sogs rdzas gzhan rnams kyang gcig tu dam tshig de 'bul tshul de dang 'phra/ yang na zhi ba dang drag gsum la'ang 'dod gsol kha bsgyur zhing*/ shin+taṃ/ wa shaṃ/ ma ra yā/ sogs byar bar bya'o/ las bzhi dang khyad par rgyas pa gtso ring nge 'dzin gyi gzer kha ni sgo la ngar gyis gdabs bzhin yig la/ dmigs pa ni/ lha thams cad dgyes pa chen po'i ngang nas las (537)mthun gyi 'od zer/ kha bsgyur byas la rgyas par la/ ser po 'phros pas gang 'dod gyi phris 'grub par bsam/

la mnyam par 'jog rdzas rdo rdzogs ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ye swā hā/ goms zung dang*/ badz+ra taṃ bu la ya swā hā: zhes po rtsa'i 'bul lo/ tshogs mchod rgyas par 'bul nas dngos grub blang ba'i rdzes thog du gtang rag la/ oṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni/ sogs nas bstod pa'i bar dang*/ hūm̐/ dgong blugs dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i sogs nas gshed skyems lan bdun dang rdzas rnams rim bzhin phul/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mjod/ sogs kyis mthar badz+ra mu: ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig sa rang la 'dres par bsam/ de nas bsngo ba ni/ mkha' 'gro ma yi dkyil 'khor du/ sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di phul ba'i/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa/ 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ smon lam ni/ (538)ho/ snang srid thams cad po ta la yi zhing*/ bde chen 'gyur med rdo rje rnam rgyal ma/ rnam kun mchog ldan rgyal yum sgrol ma dang*/ rang zhal 'jal te mngon par byang chub shog bkra shis ni/ stobs bcu'i dbang phyug rigs lnga'i yum/ sogs tsha/ bkra shis shog ces dang*/ a ka ro brjod cing 'o ma dang dri bzang gi tshung mi brtul zhing skabs rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing rjogs rim gzhung ltar bya/ de ltar mi mchod byed pa yan mo ni dkyil 'khor lha yi zhal/ mngon sum nyid du longs spyod pas/ bsod nams nang nas sbyin sreng chog rnam la myur ba'i las brtson chas/ rnal 'byor ldan las 'di la yang dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ sa ma ya: ces pa'ang mang gzhi'i sbyin sreg kha bsgyur gang la chog pa ni yang sngags rigs sa dbon tshul khrims bzang po'i ngor chon kyi bdag po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis kha skang du bris pa dge //
